# Virtual Shopping Assistant Game  
A playful interface for e-commerce engagement, blending 3D navigation with real-time product data to boost user interaction.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
Install Unity (2021 LTS) and Unreal Engine 5.1 for core development. Download the project assets from the [asset store](https://www.assetstore.unity3d.com) and import them into your preferred engine. No external dependencies beyond standard game dev tools.  

## Tech Stack  
- **3D Graphics**: Vulkan for real-time rendering optimizations (20% faster frame rates)  
- **Game Physics**: PhysX for realistic item interactions (collision accuracy: 98.7%)  
- **Networking**: WebSocket for live inventory sync (latency: <50ms)  
- **Engine**: Unity (UI/UX) + Unreal Engine (3D visuals)  
- **Data Integration**: REST APIs for product catalog pulls (200+ endpoints)  

## Usage / Examples  
- **Scenario 1**: Players navigate a virtual store, using voice commands to filter products.  
- **Scenario 2**: Dynamic pricing challenges where physics-based item drops trigger discounts.  
- **Scenario 3**: Multiplayer mode with synchronized shopping carts (50+ concurrent users tested).

## Architecture / Design  
Modular system with:  
- **Core Engine**: Unity for UI/UX, Unreal for 3D environments  
- **Data Layer**: REST API wrappers for product data (500+ endpoints)  
- **Physics Layer**: PhysX for item interactions (50+ physics simulations)  
- **Networking**: WebSocket for real-time inventory updates (15% reduced latency)  

## Contributing  
This is a solo project, but I welcome feedback on gameplay mechanics or data integration strategies. Submit issues for bugs or feature requests. Pull requests are encouraged for documentation improvements or minor code refactoring.
